gen-gf-revalia-gf-vend-sans: Loud, loose and wide-striding, Revalia plants its tall letters apart. Vend Sans is a sans drawn with a ruler's constancy and a tall x-height, so paragraphs glide past without snagging.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ubuntu-sans: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its tall letters, while Ubuntu Sans rounds out the line with tubular curves. What lingers is that bent-copper-pipe roundness, soft against the stencil.
gen-tourney-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mon: Athletic and stretched out, Tourney spaces its bulky letters wide. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono steps in beneath with sans-serif openness, so the page gets a sprinter's burst then an easy stroll.
gen-tourney-gf-chivo: Heavy, stretched, unmistakably sporty: Tourney keeps its strokes uniform, and Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps. Daylight in Chivo's curves keeps the loud heading from crowding it.
gen-tourney-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads open, its bodies dominating the line while ascenders barely register, beneath the stretched words of Tourney. Across long pages, that sans glides along without any hurry.
gen-tourney-gf-funnel-sans: Tourney's bulky, oversized small letters are stretched out by wide tracking. Funnel Sans keeps its strokes steady and its e pried open, so text moves smoothly through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-tourney-gf-gidole: Bulky, wide-tracked and uniform in stroke, Tourney shouts across the line. And Gidole steps in with neon-tube-consistent strokes and open terminals, a sans that lets the shouting settle down.
gen-tourney-gf-heebo: Chunky, stretched and gloriously loud, Tourney keeps its line weight gently monotone. But Heebo is the one doing the quiet work, a sans with a tall central band and curves that stop short.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-vadodara: Stretched, stocky and sporty, Tourney keeps every stroke uniform. Hind Vadodara, a sans with spacious terminal gaps and tall-bowled e and a, gives the page somewhere to rest beneath it.
gen-tourney-gf-karla: Bold, swell-free and widely tracked, Tourney rides over Karla, a sans with a gaping c and a stocky middle band. Sturdiness is what they share, and what makes them click.
